rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The identified_bias_summary reports four labels with one occurrence each, matching the four identified_occurrences. One additional finding is correctly represented as a candidate.

evaluation_limitations: No retrieved chunks, source passages, or retrieval logs were supplied, so corpus retrieval fidelity cannot be scored.
The hindsight-bias signal is retained as a candidate because the retrospective statement is compatible with ordinary after-action reflection as well as hindsight bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 1: initial size-up and retrospective reflection
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Dispatch said small trash fire ... The smoke was heavier than I'd expect ... I didn't want to lose time doing a full walk-around. Later: That smoke column at the very start was heavier than a trash fire should produce ... the signs were there from minute one.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC cites the dispatched call type as the primary reason for committing the quick-knockdown line, acknowledges heavier-than-expected smoke, but declines a full 360 before committing. In the closing reflection, the IC says the early smoke made the escalation obvious and that the signs were there from minute one, after learning about the drums and hazmat complications.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 2: chemical identification and PPE/agent selection
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The tech's read was that it lined up with a common solvent ... the manager ... said ... it's something different ... We didn't weight it heavily ... the placard read supported what we already expected to find.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC treats the partially legible placard as supporting the assumed common solvent, discounts the manager's contrary statement because he was rattled, and proceeds with solvent-specific PPE and foam without independent verification.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 3: isolation-perimeter distance under shifting wind
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Wind had started shifting toward the residential block ... recalculating and moving all of that would've been a real disruption, and nobody else seemed to be flagging it as a problem. So I left it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC remembers wanting to push the 150-meter line out as wind shifted, but leaves it because mutual-aid units and the battalion chief were already set up and nobody else flagged a problem.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 4: go/no-go decision on completing the interior search
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We can't call this search done and leave one room unaccounted for ... Framed that way, leaving it unresolved felt like accepting a gap we couldn't defend. So I authorized the crew to go finish it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC says the battalion chief framed leaving one room as an indefensible gap after clearing 90%, which led to authorizing re-entry despite fatigue and unresolved chemical risk near the drums.

segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The high-confidence anchoring occurrence is a full match. The hindsight occurrence is correctly withheld from identified findings and promoted only at the candidate-inclusive threshold.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_002 uses exact interview quotations from the chemical-identification and PPE-selection episode in the prevalidated segment.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Confirmation bias is correctly identified and localized, but its low confidence excludes it from the first two thresholds.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_003 exactly quotes the participant's private doubt and deference to the already accepted 150-meter perimeter.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Social proof bias is an accepted equivalent for the hidden Bandwagon effect label, with a full mechanism match and moderate confidence.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_004 quotes the battalion chief's externally supplied frame and the participant's resulting authorization of re-entry.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Framing effect is an exact label and mechanism match, but moderate confidence excludes it from the high-only threshold.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Strategy commitment insufficiently adjusted away from the initial dispatch-provided call description despite contrary visual cues.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring effect is an established equivalent label for the hidden Anchoring Bias target.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding directly identifies reliance on the dispatch label despite the heavier observed smoke and failure to perform the rear 360 before commitment.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Quoted evidence is present in the raw interview and accurately supports the contemporaneous mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Retrospective reflection on the early smoke column
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Retrospective overstatement of the foreseeability of escalation, given outcome knowledge unavailable at the time of the original decision.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The candidate uses the exact hidden target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate correctly connects the closing statement that the signs were present from minute one to retrospective overstatement after learning the outcome, while acknowledging the plausible ordinary-reflection interpretation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quote is valid and localized to the retrospective portion of decision point 1; the candidate status appropriately reflects ambiguity rather than unsupported certainty.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Selective interpretation of ambiguous placard/manifest evidence as consistent with the prior solvent assumption, paired with active discounting of a contradicting occupant statement.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The predicted label exactly matches the hidden target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures interpreting the partial placard as support for the solvent hypothesis, discounting the occupant's contradiction, and failing to seek independent confirmation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The cited statements are verbatim interview evidence and the low-confidence caveat accurately preserves the documented non-bias interpretation.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Perimeter adjustment decision after wind shift
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Adoption of an already-established perimeter distance because multiple other units and a superior officer are already operating on it, despite unresolved personal doubt.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Social proof bias is an established equivalent social-influence label for the hidden Bandwagon effect target in this context.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the participant's private concern, the converging behavior of multiple officers, and the decision to leave the perimeter unchanged because others were not flagging a problem.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The occurrence uses a verbatim quote and accurately preserves both the social convergence and the legitimate operational-inertia counterexplanation.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Final search room entry under unresolved hazards
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Decision outcome shifts based on the battalion chief's effort/loss-oriented verbal framing of the choice, rather than independent evaluation of the underlying chemical risk.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The predicted label exactly matches the hidden target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding identifies the chief's loss-oriented verbal framing and its effect on authorizing entry despite fatigue, unresolved chemical identity, and drum-integrity risk.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is valid and the analysis correctly distinguishes the framing mechanism from the legitimate life-safety objective of completing a search.

candidates.details: The candidate uses the exact hidden label, validly quotes the retrospective statement, and articulates the outcome-knowledge mechanism. Candidate status is appropriate because the participant also noticed the smoke contemporaneously and the statement can reflect normal after-action reflection.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence-only detection finds the anchoring segment but misses the moderate-confidence bandwagon and framing segments and the low-confidence confirmation segment.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Including moderate-confidence identified findings recovers the bandwagon and framing segments without introducing false alarms; the low-confidence confirmation segment remains missed.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: All four eligible positive segments are detected by identified findings when low-confidence findings are included.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Candidate inclusion does not change segment-level detection because the segment already contains the high-confidence anchoring finding; it adds the distinct hindsight instance at the instance level.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly states that no retrieved corpus passages were provided, and all identified occurrences report unavailable corpus support with empty corpus_evidence arrays.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 1 to 3 and strict/mechanism-first true positives increase from 1 to 3, with no false positives.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Segment hits increase from 3 to 4 and strict/mechanism-first true positives increase from 3 to 4 by admitting the low-confidence confirmation finding, with no false positives.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Segment metrics remain unchanged; strict/mechanism-first true positives increase from 4 to 5 because the hindsight candidate is promoted at the candidate-inclusive threshold, with no false positives.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 3 of 4 positive segments are detected (hit rate 0.75, F1 0.8571) with no false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 3 of 5 hidden instances are true positives with precision 1.0, recall 0.6, and F1 0.75; all four identified findings are exact or approved-label matches when all identified confidence levels are included.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first results are identical to strict results at every threshold because every matched finding has an accepted label and a full mechanism match.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate tier is useful: it preserves uncertainty around hindsight bias while correctly promoting that distinct instance at the fourth threshold, raising instance-level recall from 0.8 to 1.0 without adding a false positive.
main_failure_modes: The low-confidence confirmation finding is missed at the high_and_moderate comparison threshold.
The hindsight occurrence is not identified as a firm finding and is available only through candidate-inclusive scoring.
High-only scoring is conservative and misses three of the five hidden instances.
main_strengths: All identified findings are correctly localized and supported by valid interview quotations.
The anchoring, bandwagon/social-proof, confirmation, and framing mechanisms are accurately described.
The output contains no unsupported or duplicate predictions and uses an appropriate candidate abstention for hindsight bias.
Corpus limitations are explicitly disclosed rather than overstated.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect precision and no false alarms across all thresholds, but confidence calibration controls recall. The recommended high_and_moderate threshold provides a strong precision-recall balance, while the candidate tier recovers the final hindsight instance without degrading precision.
